_about: Land-combat constants for the tactical simulator. Entries with source 'install' were read by hand from a 1.19.5 install (file and line noted); 'estimate' and 'sim' entries are not in the game files and are the calibration knobs for stage 1 (docs/tactics.md).

hit_rate.source: sim: hit attempts per point of attack per hour; calibration knob, not in the files

hit_pass_scale.source: sim: A/(A+D) is multiplied by this, so equal attack and defense passes 1.0

min_org_to_attack.source: sim: fraction of max org below which a division will not start or join an attack

rotation_org.source: sim: fraction of max org below which a division in a battle is replaced by a fresher one in reserve

disengage_org_loss.source: sim: fraction of max org lost pulling out of a live battle

extra_direction_width.source: sim: extra combat width (fraction) per additional attack direction

edge_length_km.source: sim: default distance between province centres

combat_speed_factor.source: install COMBAT_MOVEMENT_SPEED (unused: units in combat do not move)

org_regain_per_hour_fraction.source: sim: fraction of max org regained per hour when not fighting and supplied

str_reinforce_per_hour_fraction.source: sim: fraction of max strength reinforced per hour, supplied and not fighting

encircled_attrition_per_hour_fraction.source: sim: fraction of max strength lost per hour after the supply grace, standing in for OUT_OF_SUPPLY_ATTRITION

supply_range_hops.source: sim: full supply within this many provinces of a hub

supply_falloff_per_hop.source: sim: supply fraction lost per hop beyond the range

armor.source: install common/units/medium_armor.txt (per-battalion attack modifiers; movement modifiers not modelled)

infantry.source: install units/infantry.txt (width, hp, org) and equipment/infantry.txt infantry_equipment_1 (stats); speed 4 is the equipment maximum_speed

medium_armor.source: width and org scale from units/medium_armor.txt, armor 30 and speed 5 from equipment/tank_chassis.txt medium_tank_chassis_1; hp, attack, piercing, breakthrough are ESTIMATES (module stats not parsed)
